description: Shared Renovate preset for lexfrei repositories. Extend via { "extends": ["github>lexfrei/renovate-config"] }.

pip_requirements.description: Also track the .in sources pip-compile locks are generated from. The default patterns match the compiled .txt only, so a bump moved the lock and left the source behind — and a repo that checks the two agree then fails CI on every update.

packageRules.description: Let Renovate bump the go directive in go.mod (needs GOTOOLCHAIN=auto or a matching setup-go in CI)

Bump Go modules in one PR. Renovate automerges at most one branch per repository per run, so each module otherwise waits for a run of its own. Majors still split into their own group PR, and security fixes leave the group because vulnerabilityAlerts carries groupName: null. Must stay ABOVE the kubernetes and go toolchain groups: the last matching rule wins, so they re-claim k8s.io/* and the go directive from this broader one.
Keep controller-runtime in lockstep with the Kubernetes libraries (a split bump breaks compilation: controller-runtime vX needs a matching client-go)

Bump the go directive and the golang base image together. Apart, the directive lands first and the builder image still ships an older patch release; since the directive is a hard minimum, `go mod download` then fails inside the image and every Go PR in the repo goes red at once. Matched by datasource rather than by manager so a regex manager tracking the same version (a docs page, a tool pin) joins the group too.

Bump GitHub Actions in one PR rather than one per action. Renovate automerges at most one branch per repository per run, so a repo onboarding with a dozen action updates drained one per run over a day; grouped, they land together. Majors still split into their own group PR by default. Same name as the per-repo rules some repos already carry, so those agree with this one instead of competing.

customManagers.description: Bump tool versions annotated with a '# renovate:' comment in workflows and the Makefile (golangci-lint, go, templ, ...)
Bump pinned apk packages annotated with a '# renovate: datasource=repology depName=alpine_<ver>/<pkg>' comment in Containerfiles and Dockerfiles
